description: This file provides a data access layer for interacting with a PostgreSQL database using asyncpg. It includes functions to initialize and close a connection pool, perform queries for a single record or multiple records, execute update/insert/delete statements, and batch execution. It manages a global pool instance and exposes utility functions for other modules to perform safe, parameterized database operations.

methods.name: asyncpg.Pool _create_pool(database_url: str)
methods.description: Creates an asyncpg connection pool with specified configuration parameters.

methods.name: None init_db_pool()
methods.description: Initializes the global database connection pool if the DATABASE_URL is configured.

methods.name: None close_db_pool()
methods.description: Closes the existing global connection pool if it exists.

methods.name: asyncpg.Pool _ensure_pool_available()
methods.description: Internal helper that checks if the connection pool is initialized and raises an error if not.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_one(sql: str, *params: Any)
methods.description: Performs a query and returns a single record as a dictionary or None.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_all(sql: str, *params: Any)
methods.description: Performs a query and returns a list of all matching records as dictionaries.

methods.name: str execute(sql: str, *params: Any)
methods.description: Executes an INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE statement and returns the command status string.

methods.name: List[str] execute_many(sql: str, param_sets: List[Tuple[Any, ...]])
methods.description: Performs batch execution of a statement with multiple parameter sets, returning a list of statuses.

ctags.name: execute_many
ctags.pattern: /^async def execute_many(sql: str, param_sets: List[Tuple[Any, ...]]) -> List[str]:$/

ctags.name: fetch_all
ctags.pattern: /^async def fetch_all(sql: str, *params: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: fetch_one
ctags.pattern: /^async def fetch_one(sql: str, *params: Any) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
